children: Jaguar Land Rover said on Monday it would cut around 4,000 jobs globally over the next two years as part of a broader plan to reduce costs and improve competitiveness.
The company said it was targeting £1.7 billion ($2.30 billion) of savings and launching five new products over the next 12 months.
